note: Phases describe the intended order of work and the conditions for moving on. They are planning categories, not delivery commitments, and carry no dates. A milestone is marked Completed only when there is evidence for it.

legendText.research: Open investigation, no commitment to build
legendText.conditional: Only happens if earlier results justify it

phases.title: Foundation & Product Definition
phases.summary: Brand, website, documentation, product research and the Ovia Protect requirements.
phases.gate: Approved requirements for Ovia Protect V1, including a selected way to discover approvals at zero additional cost.

milestones.title: Ovia Labs brand identity
milestones.evidence: Logo set and brand system in use across the website and this documentation.

milestones.title: Ovia Protect V1 requirements (PRDs)
milestones.evidence: V1 was built from them and released as the public beta.

milestones.title: PRD-010: approval discovery feasibility test
milestones.evidence: Validation report dated 17 November 2026. On-chain verification through a free public Ethereum RPC: GO. The free third-party approval API tested as a discovery source: NO-GO.

milestones.title: Select an approval discovery approach
milestones.evidence: Historical Approval events through a public RPC gateway with a fallback endpoint, every result verified with allowance() at a pinned block.

phases.title: Ovia Protect V1 & Public Beta
phases.summary: Architecture, implementation and release of the first version as a public beta.
phases.gate: A working public beta that verifies every displayed allowance on-chain at a recorded block and shows its known gaps.

milestones.title: Browser-only architecture
milestones.evidence: The beta runs entirely in the browser against public RPC endpoints. No Ovia server, no stored scans.

milestones.title: Read-only ERC-20 approval scanner (Ethereum Mainnet)
milestones.evidence: Public beta live at protect.ovialabs.xyz since 18 November 2026.

phases.title: Protect Validation & Product Expansion
phases.summary: Learn from the beta, add revoking with the user’s own wallet, measure and publish limitations, and arrange an independent review.
phases.gate: Ovia Protect leaves beta: coverage measured and published, independent review completed.

milestones.title: Public beta with early users
milestones.evidence: Beta open to everyone since 18 November 2026.

milestones.title: Revoke approvals inside Ovia Protect, with your own wallet
milestones.detail: Next step. Ovia Protect would ask your wallet to sign approve(spender, 0); it never holds keys or sends transactions for you.

milestones.title: Accuracy and coverage testing, results published
milestones.detail: Compare results with an independent source and publish the measured coverage.

milestones.title: Independent security review
milestones.detail: Not done yet. Required before Ovia Protect leaves beta.

phases.title: Ovia Network Research
phases.summary: Exploring verification models, architecture, trust assumptions and feasibility.
phases.gate: A written feasibility assessment, published for review.

phases.title: Ecosystem Expansion & Token Feasibility
phases.summary: Evaluating whether broader network infrastructure and token mechanisms are technically, economically and legally justified.
phases.gate: A positive technical, economic and legal assessment. A negative outcome is an acceptable result.
